changelog:
Add optional per-user light-state restoration policies with global inheritance
Leave restoration fields blank to inherit the global capture/restore setting
Capture the effective restoration policy at playback startup for consistent pause and cleanup behavior
Report the active restoration policy in sanitized runtime status and the configuration page
Add regression coverage for restoration resolution, persistence, lifecycle behavior, and status/API wiring
See CHANGELOG.md for the complete release history
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, scene restoration, per-user bridge mappings, playback performance and restoration profiles, advanced color processing, and auto-reconnection.
